name: Fractal canyon
description: A flight down a folded fractal canyon with a road running through it. There is no light and no ambient occlusion — the surface is coloured by its normal and outlined by edge detection, which is what gives it an inked, cel-shaded look instead of a rendered one.

waves.description: Roll of the canyon floor as it comes past.

ink.description: Weight of the detected edges. At 0 the outlines vanish and it becomes a normal-mapped surface.

tint.description: How far the normal colouring is pulled into the run's palette. At 0 it keeps the raw red/green/blue normal look.
